method.scope: Development on the same conventional marked sheet, same full FSM, safety checks, signed gates and actual 9-10 mm score. No terminal signal inferred from actuation count, reaching ready, supervision or a previous image.
method.method: After a failed normal 3-mm closed look use the remaining CLEAR_VIEW attempts, within the original global ECM movement budget, for real registered camera targets instead of parking before confirming the endpoint. Switch to native HD 70-degree optics only for that recovery and preserve metric optical history. Keep both labels and scissors in the same actual RGB-D observation. While still uncut, hold a lost view within the existing occlusion-wait interval, refresh the pre-cut optical initialization and require real fresh entry evidence (never reset cut history after a closure).
method.noise_guard: When depth noise is enabled, reduce the forward distance permitted by the modeled endpoint sweep by one configured noise sigma before motion. No subtraction from the final fresh guard check; never advance on negative budget. Do not alter any pose error, optics validation, structural interval or stop/acceptance threshold.
method.scoring: Use the parent scorer and all five cases, recording every attempt and actual rendered recovery image pair. Report all results; no signed acceptance or independent runs.
